trigger: User received Cloudflare notification that Workers KV free-tier daily operations reached 50%.
action: Keep the frozen 60-second sampling cadence inside each burst, but start a new burst only when the last persisted receipt is at least 3000 seconds old. Scheduled bursts use 11 samples (~10 minutes); push-triggered due bursts use at most 6 samples.
expectedEffect: Reduce relay/KV request rate during the active shadow trial by roughly 80% versus near-continuous minute sampling, while preserving v1's 30-90 second consecutive-sample definition inside each observed burst.
limitations: Cloudflare KV operations per relay request were not independently measured, so the exact percentage reduction in KV operations is not proven.
Coverage becomes intentionally sparse between bursts; those gaps remain unobserved and reset candidate baselines.
The normal post-trial collector remains on its existing schedule because the throttle only applies while phase=trial.
